title: Cave Stuff Recaved
description: Just another cave mod yeah biomes and all that stuff
body:
**BEWARE MOD WAS A BIT RUSHED GULP....
AND THAT THE MOD IS STILL WIP!!!!!1**

Cave stuff recaved is a remake of my first released mod called... Cave stuff.. yeah... It aims to add cave animals, plants, fungus, rocks into minecraft (and some evil lore) Rn it adds:

-1 biome: Guano caves

-7 unique mobs

-And a lot of food, stone types, plants, mushrooms and a new mineral

Mod requires geckolib and is made in mcreator... yeah :P. Expect more GUBBY updates.

Thank you for playing and report any bugs or suggest stuff!!!!!1!!11!!
